note: WAEC Financial Accounting round 8 (R41 top-up): issued capital; called-up capital; rights issue; credit note; internal audit; historical cost; accrual concept; matching concept; the cash book's double role; personal, real and nominal accounts; the balance sheet as a statement; retained earnings; provision increase charged to P&L; fixed capital account; fluctuating capital; partner's salary via appropriation; sinking fund; amortisation of a lease; the post-dated cheque; the AGM; shareholders' limited liability; under-subscription. Scanned against the whole Accounting pool (WAEC, NECO and JAMB stems).
